releases.name: v0.2.2 – Video background jobs
releases.body:
`opencode-subagent-tools` 0.2.2 adds background video job tracking. A video job that keeps running after `generate_video` returns now appears as `video` in `backgroundJob.kinds` and keeps the session active through `active` and `subtreeActive`, even when its execution status is `finished`.

> **Upgrade note:** 0.2.2 keeps the OpenCode 2.3.0+ requirement. The `video` kind appears only on OpenCode 2.4.0+; older versions never send it. Background probes now recognize both `generate_image` (2.4.0+) and `experimental_image_generate` (2.3.x).

## Added

- `video` in `backgroundJob.kinds` for `list`, `usage`, `cancel`, `cancel_descendants`, `steer`, `queue`, and `context`.
- Video jobs are read from `experimental.idle` snapshots by output path and count toward `active`, `subtreeActive`, and the activity counts. A running `generate_video` tool part is also recognized as best-effort evidence.
- `cancel` and `cancel_descendants` report video jobs like other background work; they cannot stop an idle job.

## Changed

- Tested against `@opencode/plugin` 2.4.1.
- No public output fields changed; `backgroundJob.kinds` gains only the new `video` value.

## Fixed

- Background probes recognize the current `generate_image` tool name and the older `experimental_image_generate` name. The probe no longer looks for a nonexistent `image` tool name.

**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools/blob/v0.2.2/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: v0.2.1 – Code Mode background jobs
releases.body:
`opencode-subagent-tools` 0.2.1 adds Code Mode background job tracking. A Code Mode script that keeps running after its tool call returns now appears as `codemode` in `backgroundJob.kinds` and keeps the session active through `active` and `subtreeActive`, even when its execution status is `finished`.

> **Upgrade note:** 0.2.1 keeps the OpenCode 2.3.0+ requirement. The new `codemode` kind appears only on 2.3.1+; on 2.3.0 the plugin works as before.

## Added

- `codemode` in `backgroundJob.kinds` for `list`, `usage`, `cancel`,  `cancel_descendants`, `steer`, `queue`, and `context`.
- Code Mode jobs are read from `experimental.idle` snapshots by job ID and count toward `active`, `subtreeActive`, and the activity counts.

## Changed

- Tested against `@opencode/plugin` 2.3.2.
- `cancel` reports a known Code Mode job but cannot stop it, and its context probe cannot discover one; only the idle hook can.

## Fixed

- A Code Mode idle item no longer falls into the unknown-kind path and marks its owner `stateUnknown`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools/blob/v0.2.1/CHANGELOG.md

releases.name: v0.2.0 – Background activity tracking
releases.body:
`opencode-subagent-tools` 0.2.0 adds background activity tracking. An idle child that still owns a shell, image, or subagent job is now visible through `active` and `subtreeActive`, even when its execution status is `finished`.

> **Upgrade note:** 0.2.0 requires OpenCode 2.3.0+. If you are on 2.2.5, stay on 0.1.0.

## Added

- Background job tracking from the experimental idle hook, shell events, and structured context probes.
- `list`: `active`, `subtreeActive`, `activeDescendants`, `backgroundJob`, `activeCount`, `subtreeActiveCount`, and the `active` / `subtreeActive` filters.
- `usage`: `active`, optional `subtreeActive` with `includeDescendants`, `backgroundJob`, and background-aware lag flags.
- `cancel`: `active`, `backgroundJob`, an on-demand probe for idle or terminal targets, and `mayRemain` / `stateUnknown`.
- `cancel_descendants`: `activeCount`, `subtreeActiveCount`, `backgroundJobCount`, `backgroundJobMayRemain`, and per-target background jobs.
- `queue`: `queued`; `steer`, `queue`, and `context`: `active` and `backgroundJob`. `queue` waits for the current execution, not background jobs, which continue in parallel.

## Changed

- Requires OpenCode 2.3.0+.
- `usageMayLag` covers active sessions with background work, not only running or unknown executions.

## Fixed

- An idle event no longer overrides a known terminal status.
- `cancel` no longer prints only "no interrupt was needed" when an idle target owns background work.
- `cancel_descendants` reports idle background jobs instead of returning an unqualified "No running subagents".

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-subagent-tools
```

Or from GitHub:

```sh
opencode plugin add github:finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools
```

releases.name: v0.1.0 – Initial release
releases.body:
Initial release of `opencode-subagent-tools`.

Seven tools for OpenCode V2 that give an agent explicit control over its subagent sessions:

- `subagent_list` — discover children and inspect status, cost, and usage.
- `subagent_usage` — read cost, tokens, current context, and optional tree totals.
- `subagent_cancel` — stop one session with a soft interrupt.
- `subagent_cancel_descendants` — stop the caller's running descendants in batches.
- `subagent_steer` — send an instruction at the child's next model request.
- `subagent_queue` — queue a message as the next independent turn.
- `subagent_context` — inject a synthetic context message without starting a turn.

Highlights:

- Discovery through `ctx.session.list`, including nested descendants.
- Text or JSON output per call, with per-tool defaults.
- Permission checks through `subagent.control` and configurable `sessionControlPolicy`.
- Cursor-based pagination for `list` and `cancel_descendants`.
- Bundled `SKILL.md` with operational guidance.
- Configurable discovery, list, cancellation, and text limits.

Requirements: OpenCode 2.2.5+ with `ctx.session.list`.

Install:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-subagent-tools
```

Or from GitHub:

```sh
opencode plugin add github:finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools
```

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

Docs: [README](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools#readme)
